context: A screenshot of nyc-live, a 3D map of lower Manhattan rendered in a web browser, seen from straight above with north at the top. The ground layer draws land, water and street centrelines.

checks.name: water_west_and_east
checks.instructions: A large land area fills the middle of the view, and it borders water (a distinctly coloured, mostly street-free area) both on its west (left) side and on its east (right) side.

checks.name: street_grid
checks.instructions: A street grid is visible on the land: many thin lines that form city blocks.

checks.name: no_square_grid
checks.instructions: No plain square grid is visible: there is no evenly spaced lattice of identical squares, like a 3D editor's floor grid, covering the view. Streets of varying spacing and direction do not count as such a grid.
